'''Suin Chalo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] that lived on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was imprisoned in a crystal in the [[Chamber of Banishment]] with [[Axkva Min]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] entered the Chamber of Banishment and killed the imprisoned [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Suin Chalo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Suin Chalo was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Axkva Min|"Axkva Min" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:AM" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
